## Observation (read from the configuration, not measured on CI)

The test job installs the wheel and then runs `python -m pytest` from the checkout root. `python -m` puts the current directory first on `sys.path`, so `import cyclophaser` in the tests can resolve to the checked-out source tree rather than to the installed wheel. The comment at the top of the file says the job checks what a `pip install cyclophaser` user gets. Whether it does was not measured here.
